verdict.rationale: Namecheap exposes a programmable API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence shows only raw XML endpoints (production and sandbox), a Go SDK method table and a Terraform provider README, and none of these is an interactive, runnable API reference. The sandbox endpoint is a separate test environment, not an in-docs try-it explorer, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
